messages:
sara: quick check — for the /v1/conversations.generate endpoint: are we keeping the 'role' field required on each message? also curious about streaming behavior for function calls: will clients see partial 'function_call' pieces as deltas or only a final object? cc @kevin @jia

kevin: yes, keep 'role' required (helps routing & safety filters). for streaming: we will emit function_call as a sequence of delta chunks (name + args fragments) and a final marker. runtime reassembles into one object for non-streaming clients.

jia: add to that: document that clients can opt into a simpler mode by setting prefer_final=true which suppresses deltas and returns only the final function_call in the stream. defaults remain backwards-compatible (deltas ON).

andy: fwiw, backward-compat note: older SDKs that only expect a single function_call object may break when consuming deltas — prefer_final=true is the recommended mitigation. we should add a migration note and a small example.

deploy-bot: deploy queued — docs + runtime changes targeting prod at 16:00 UTC. CI status: all green.

kevin: i'll open a tiny PR with the docs snippet + unit tests for reassembly: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5678

sara: can someone paste a minimal streaming payload example for the docs here? a quick code block would be perfect.

kevin: sure — example stream events (newline-delimited JSON events):
```
{ "type": "delta", "choices": [{ "delta": { "role": "assistant" } }] }
{ "type": "delta", "choices": [{ "delta": { "function_call": { "name": "get_weather" } } }] }
{ "type": "delta", "choices": [{ "delta": { "function_call": { "arguments": "{ \"loc\": \"NYC\"" } } }] }
{ "type": "delta", "choices": [{ "delta": { "function_call": { "arguments": " , \"units\": \"metric\" }" } }] }
{ "type": "final", "choices": [{ "message": { "role": "assistant", "function_call": { "name": "get_weather", "arguments": "{ \"loc\": \"NYC\", \"units\": \"metric\" }" } } }] }
```

jia: nice — docs should explicitly call out that argument fragments need concatenation in arrival order and that clients must validate JSON after concatenation. add a sausage test for argument boundary cases.

andy: small ops ask — can we make the final event include a stable 'event_id' so replays/dedup are easier? not required but helpful.

kevin: i'll add event_id to the final envelope. tests + docs updated in PR 5678. will ping for reviews.

deploy-bot: prod deploy started — docs change included.

jia: reviewing the PR now, will leave comments by EOD.

sara: thanks everyone — once merged i'll update the migration note in the changelog and ping support to warn customers. :thumbsup:

kevin: done — added changelog entry and a short note in the SDK migration guide. link in PR. :rocket:

andy: thanks. i'm going to add a short sample snippet for the JS SDK showing `stream.on('delta', ...)` reassembly helper.

sara: perfect. that should cover the quick-check. we'll follow up if anything pops during review.
